subject: general
question: The sum of the perimeter of two cubes, the length of whose edges are x cm and y cm, respectively, is 300 cm and the product of edges x and y is 156 cm². Find the sum of the volume of both cubes.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Sum of **perimeters** of two **cubes** = 12(x + y) = 300 → x + y = 25 cm.

Given **product of edges** (xy) = 156 cm².

Sum of **volumes** = x³ + y³ = (x + y)((x + y)² − 3xy).

x³ + y³ = 25 × (25² − 3 × 156) = 25 × (625 − 468) = 25 × 157 = 3925 cm³.

**∴ The correct answer is 3925 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Total perimeter = 300 cm, Product of edges (xy) = 156 cm².

**Formula:** Perimeter of a cube = 12 × edge; Volume = edge³.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b2ed1338349249a950c6c01d691989456c29e01a834ca7834b1c05f3046ac433.png] 

⇒ 12x + 12y = 300

⇒ 12(x + y) = 300 ⇒ x + y = 25

⇒ Sum of volumes = x³ + y³

⇒ x³ + y³ = (x + y)³ − 3xy(x + y)

⇒ x³ + y³ = (25)³ − 3(156)(25)

⇒ x³ + y³ = 15625 − 11700

⇒ x³ + y³ = 3925 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 3925 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Cube Properties

Total surface area of a cube is 6a² and the longest diagonal is a√3, where a is the edge length.

Algebraic Identity

The sum of cubes formula: a³ + b³ = (a + b)(a² − ab + b²) or (a + b)³ − 3ab(a + b).

Perimeter of 3D shapes

The total edge length (perimeter) of a cube/cuboid is the sum of all 12 edges.</p
